description: 10 permanent solo YouTube slots — 2 Render sidecars × 5 encoders each (Tier C / option C: 1080p @ 6800k per sidecar on pro_ultra). All Twitch — Kick removed 2026-06-22; B8 funnymike, B10 yonnajay.
fleetPausedReason: Operator hold — YouTube lifecycle desync investigation (2026-06-23). Clear fleetPaused before START FLEET.

orchestration.rule: Slot-locked mirror — Twitch live state drives YouTube slot live state on both sidecars.
behaviors: Each slot is permanently bound to one Twitch streamer. Roster changes are rare (weekly at most).
When the locked streamer goes live on Twitch → start ingest + encode for that slot → create or reuse that slot's YouTube broadcast → prelive (RTMP/testing) → full SEO → public on ClipzWorld News.
YouTube broadcasts are NOT pre-created at roster setup — only reusable RTMP stream keys. No Studio Upcoming until source is live.
When the locked streamer goes offline → stop that slot's encode and end that slot's YouTube live on ClipzWorld News. Other slots are unaffected.
When the same streamer goes live again → same slot, same YouTube listing — no rebinding.
No grid compositor in this mode — only per-slot solo pipelines.
Sidecar A and Sidecar B use the same Twitch-only ingest path (streamlink → RTSP → solo RTMP) for stability and mirrored option-C quality.
mustNot: Leave a YouTube slot live after the source streamer ended
Start a slot without the locked streamer being live on Twitch
Swap streamers between slots without an explicit roster update
